QuestInfo.name: Fixing Blackbull's House
QuestInfo.0: I hear that #p501# in #m10004000# is fixing up his house.
QuestInfo.1: In the dusty town of #m10004000#, I ran into a man named #p501#. He needs to fix his house and asked if I could help him out by defeating #r20 #o6#s#k and #r20 #o11#s#k and getting him #b10 #t4000005#es#k and #b10 #t4000011#s#k. If I do him a favor, I'll get a nice shield from him, but what if I say no? I won't be... BANISHED from the village... will I? I really hope not...
QuestInfo.2: I got #p501# of #m10004000# 10 #t4000005#es and 10 #t4000011#s after defeating 20 #o6#s and 20 #o11#s. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward... and... well, there are scratch marks here and there, and it looks pretty old... Is this even usable?

0.0: Can you defeat #r20 #o6#s#k and #r20 #o11#s#k and get me #b10 #t4000005#es#k and #b10 #t4000011#s#k? I want to renovate my house. If you can do this for me, I will give you a nice #bshield#k that I no longer need... You should be able to get those items from the tree-like creatures nearby...

1.0: Incredible! You must be someone special, to be able to get that many. Hmm... All right, the shield is yours. It's my favorite one. Please take good care of it.

mob.0: Don't forget, you also need to defeat #r20 #o6#s#k and #r20 #o11#s#k.

item.0: I guess you still haven't collected #b10 #t4000005#es#k and #b10 #t4000011#s#k...
